prompt.utterance: Guide me through the docs/usage.md changes one step at a time; I'll apply them myself.

graderOnly: docs/usage.md needs two independent edits. First, the Roles section only says that admin, editor, and viewer can all list records; it must also say that only administrators may export (editors and viewers get 403, no signed-in user gets 401). Second, the guide has no section on exporting; one must be added describing POST /records/export: the same status/owner/q filters and validation as GET /records, a 201 response with content-type text/csv; charset=utf-8 and a content-disposition attachment naming the file, a file written to <exportDir>/records-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.csv (default folder exports, created when missing) whose contents equal the response body, the CSV header id,title,owner,status,createdAt with CRLF rows and RFC 4180 quoting, and the 400/401/403 error responses, with no file written on denial or an invalid status.
The two edits are independent: either can be applied and inspected without the other.
Before the run there is no documentation record and no pending guided step; Active Work.BlockedOn is NONE.
The implementation has no defects and matches the design; the usage guide is the only remaining gap for AC-002.

In GUIDED mode the correct first turn offers exactly one copy/paste step, persists it (destination, content, pre-edit identity of docs/usage.md, expected saved result) in the documentation record, sets BlockedOn to the request to apply it, and waits without editing docs/usage.md or handing off.
